verdict.rationale: An AI-enabled work-tracking product like Jira, with Rovo AI, could plausibly act as an MCP client, so this axis applies. The pack has no evidence that Jira can connect to external MCP servers. The only MCP evidence (jira-probe-3) is Atlassian's official MCP server, which serves Jira's tools to other agents and is a separate story. Rovo AI's connections to third-party apps and the Marketplace integrations are adjacent features, not MCP client support.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
